flawless: I warded every one of my children, and you never touched a single one.
A rune of white, a rune of blue... whichever you aimed at, I was there first.
solid: You hurt a few of my little ones. They will mend, and so will I.
Each rune I drew cost me a breath. You made me draw a great many.
close: Oh, my old heart. I have not warded so fast since I was young.
Children, help me up. That stranger nearly undid every rune I know.
